name: GitGuardian
description: Monitor GitGuardian for exposed secrets and code security incidents

checks.name: Open Secret Incidents
checks.description: Lists open (TRIGGERED/ASSIGNED) GitGuardian secret incidents. Fails if any are open; passes when none remain.

checks.name: Monitored Sources
checks.description: Verifies at least one source (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Azure DevOps repository) is connected to GitGuardian for secret scanning.
